 Stop me if you've been in this situation before: you're waiting for a phone call from a GTA character , and you just can't figure out how to trigger it. GTA 6 has the same mechanic, and even with decades of GTA experience , it can be tough to figure out exactly what you need to do to get that NPC to call you so you can keep progressing the campaign.

 Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto 6 are below.
 In GTA 6 , Halifax is one of the most infamous NPCs and will annoy you in and out of the game. Here's how to get him to call you back and clear that pesky story mission notification off your menu.
 Clear Out All Your Missions And Calls
 When playing GTA 6 , there's a general rule you should use if you're looking to progress the story:
 Checking recent contacts on your phone
 Take a 24-hour rest
 Completing every other story mission you have
 When bringing out your phone with up on the d-pad, you'll be able to check your "recents" section, at the top of the screen. This menu is different from contacts and often lists key story-related NPCs, many of whom will nudge along existing story missions you're waiting for.
 If that method doesn't work, rest at your current home until the morning, or a little longer if you want. See if someone calls you out of the blue. In that case, time was the only real motivating factor.
 Finally, there's one more thing you can try: finishing all your other story missions. This is the most time-consuming method, as it forces you to actually go on missions and finish them on the game's time. Try calling your recent contacts and resting before you take on another story mission, as you could end up with more options to choose from.
 That said, while many story missions can be triggered by making errant calls and finishing other branching story missions, Halifax is a really tricky one, since it can take 10+ hours for him to "call you back," depending on how you play the game. You'll need to exhaust every contact and complete most of the missions in Chapter 3 before you start to investigate Halifax further.
 Eventually You'll Need To Track Him Down
 To add insult to injury, Halifax never truly calls you back. Instead, Jason and Lucia will get fed up with him after completing the other story missions leading up to the confrontation and will try to find him directly. That mission will pop up and will task you with heading to his office, where you'll uncover his whereabouts.
 From there, the questline takes a more straightforward route and doesn't make you wait for a phone call nearly as long as before. Now that you've met up with Halifax, the main story can continue as normal without that lingering mission being tracked.
 There's one more run-in with Halifax after this, so keep in mind this is one of the longest plot threads in GTA 6 , partly because you have to wait so long before you can actually progress with the second arc of the story.
 10 /10
